snp3.2:1.1: Padhānasutta. Tam maṃ padhānapahitattaṃ nadiṃ Nerañjaram pati viparakkamma jhāyantaṃ yogakkhemassa pattiyā || ||
snp3.2:2.1: Namucī karuṇaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamāno upāgami: "kiso tvam asi dubbaṇṇo, santike maraṇan tava. || ||
snp3.2:3.1: Sahassabhāgo maraṇassa, ekaṃso tava jīvitaṃ, jīva bho, jīvitaṃ seyyo, jīvaṃ puññāni kāhasi. || ||
snp3.2:4.1: Carato ca te brahmacariyaṃ aggihuttañ ca jūhato pahūtaṃ cīyate puññaṃ, kiṃ padhānena kāhasi. || ||
snp3.2:5.1: Duggo maggo padhānāya dukkaro durabhisambhavo", imā gāthā bhaṇaṃ Māro aṭṭhā Buddhassa santike. || ||
snp3.2:6.1: Taṃ tathāvādinaṃ Māraṃ Bhagavā etad abravi: "pamattabandhu pāpimā, yen' atthena {idhāgato}, || ||
snp3.2:7.1: aṇumattena pi puññena attho mayhaṃ na vijjati, yesañ ca attho puññānaṃ, te Māro vattum arahati. || ||
snp3.2:8.1: Atthi saddhā tato viriyaṃ, paññā ca mama {vijjati}, evaṃ maṃ pahitattaṃ (pi) kiṃ jīvam anupucchasi. || ||
snp3.2:9.1: Nadīnam api sotāni {ayaṃ} vāto visosaye, kiñ ca me pahitattassa lohitaṃ nūpasussaye. || ||
snp3.2:10.1: Lohite sussamānamhi pittaṃ semhañ ca sussati, maṃsesu khīyamānesu bhiyyo cittaṃ pasīdati, bhiyyo sati ca paññā ca samādhi mama tiṭṭhati. || ||
snp3.2:11.1: Tassa m' evaṃ viharato pattass' uttamavedanaṃ kāmesu nāpekhate cittaṃ, passa sattassa suddhatam. || ||
snp3.2:12.1: Kāmā te paṭhamā senā, dutiyā arati vuccati, tatiyā khuppipāsā te, catutthī taṇhā pavuccati, || ||
snp3.2:13.1: pañcamī thīnamiddhaṃ te, {chaṭṭhā bhīrū} pavuccati, sattamī vicikicchā te, makkho thambho te aṭṭhamo, || ||
snp3.2:14.1: lābho siloko sakkāro micchāladdho ca yo yaso, yo c' attānaṃ samukkaṃse pare ca avajānati, || ||
snp3.2:15.1: esa Namuci te senā Kaṇhassābhippahāraṇī, na naṃ arūro jināti, jetvā ca labhate sukhaṃ. || ||
snp3.2:16.1: Esa muñjaṃ parihare, dhi-r-atthu idha jīvitaṃ, saṅgāme me mataṃ seyyo, yañce jīve parājito. || ||
snp3.2:17.1: Pagāḷhā ettha na dissanti eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā, tañ ca maggaṃ na jānanti, yena gacchanti subbatā. || ||
snp3.2:18.1: Samantā dhajiniṃ disvā yuttaṃ Māraṃ savāhanaṃ yuddhāya paccuggacchāmi, mā maṃ {ṭhānā} acāvayi. || ||
snp3.2:19.1: Yaṃ te taṃ na-ppasahati senaṃ loko sadevako,| taṃ te paññāya gacchāmi āmaṃ pattaṃ va amhanā. || ||
snp3.2:20.1: Vasiṃkaritvā saṃkappaṃ satiñ ca suppatiṭṭhitaṃ raṭṭhā raṭṭhaṃ vicarissaṃ sāvake vinayaṃ puthu. || ||
snp3.2:21.1: Te appamattā pahitattā mama sāsanakārakā akāmassa te gamissanti, yattha gantvā na socare". || ||
snp3.2:22.1: "Satta vassāni Bhagavantaṃ anubandhiṃ padā padaṃ, otāraṃ nādhigacchissaṃ Sambuddhassa satīmato. || ||
snp3.2:23.1: Medavaṇṇaṃ va pāsāṇaṃ vāyaso anupariyagā: ‘ap' ettha mudu vindema, api assādanā siyā,' || ||
snp3.2:24.1: Aladdhā tattha assādaṃ vāyas' etto apakkami, -- kāko va selaṃ āsajja nibbijjāpema Gotamaṃ". || ||
snp3.2:25.1: Tassa sokaparetassa vīṇā kacchā abhassatha, tato so dummano yakkho tatth' ev' antaradhāyathā ti || || PADHĀNASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
